analysis_type: Scale-matched LoG blob detection (~80 nm dark discs) as the PRIMARY sizing method; distance-transform watershed RESERVED to only the tightly-touching subregions where LoG merged neighbors; per-particle equivalent-circle diameters compiled into a distribution.
summary: Detected 120 particles (90 interior) via scale-matched LoG (~80 nm dark discs), primary; median diameter 69.52 nm, CV 0.120. Notes: threshold_rel=0.40 chosen by overlay both-ways check on RAW image (on-disc=120, off-disc/speckle=0, on_frac=1.00). Watershed reserved to 11 merged subregion(s) where LoG blobs touched; produced 26 split particles.
